name: birta
description: Share websites and documents with your team, clients and connected agents. Review together, leave feedback on the page, and ask your agents to make the changes.

capabilities: Share a review link with your team and clients
Discuss pages and documents with your team and clients
Apply feedback with your agent and publish the next version
Let teammates contribute through their own connected agents
Forms, visitor statistics, access controls and custom domains included
defaultPrompt: Create a presentation card about me and publish it in Birta so I can share it.
Draft a report on team and agent collaboration trends in Birta so I can leave feedback on what to change.
Help me outline a project idea, create a page for it, and publish it in Birta so I can collect feedback.
interface.longDescription:
A shared workspace where people and agents turn drafts into finished work. Share a site, report or document, leave feedback directly on it, and ask your agent to make the changes. Keep the conversation, versions and updates together at the same link.

Publish landing pages, portfolios, reports, presentations, documentation and prototypes made from HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images or Markdown. Each site gets its own address and keeps it across updates, so you can share the link once. Markdown documents open as readable pages, and a site can contain many linked pages. Published versions are saved so you can restore an earlier one.

Share the review link with teammates and clients. When link access is enabled, they can open it without an account and leave numbered comments on page elements and Markdown blocks. You can also limit review access to project participants. The review link stays the same across versions and rollbacks, while the public site address stays free of comments.

Ask your agent to read the feedback, make the requested changes, reply in each thread and mark it resolved. Share the project with teammates so they can contribute through their own agents connected to the service. Everyone works on the same project, with its versions and review threads. When you ask your agent to show the work, it publishes a version at the project address; who can open that address is the project's access setting.

Add contact forms and read the requests they collect, check visitor statistics and connect your own domain. Made for freelancers and small teams reviewing a client website, a team report or a prototype together.

Hosting supports static websites and Markdown documents, not server-side application code or PDF files as site pages. Form submissions and review access follow the project's settings and account limits.

publication.release_notes: Birta skills come to the app. Base skills: birta-setup connects Birta and asks for the first goal, birta-publish takes work to a published version and through feedback, birta-manage handles access, people, lead forms, domains and stats, plus writing, page design, diagrams, charts and binary files. Skills for a kind of work: presentation, report, proposal, landing page, portfolio, event, spec, guide and tool. Mention the agent by name in a review thread and ChatGPT can receive the mention as an event. Images, fonts and other binary files go into a draft with one HTTP send to an upload address. Projects carry tags: the project list shows them and filters by them, and a project's tags can be set when it is created or replaced later.
